name: Capstan TMVR
full_name: Capstan Medical robotic TMVR system (catheter-based robotic delivery platform)
versions: single: first-in-human cases in Santiago, early 2025 (capstan2025_press); registered first-in-human study NCT06600191 (nct06600191_capstan)
target_anatomy: transcatheter mitral valve replacement for moderate-severe or worse mitral regurgitation (nct06600191_capstan); transfemoral venous access ('up through your femoral vein', santacruzworks_capstan)
devices_driven: own steerable delivery catheter and TMVR implant (capstan2025_press; mandhumula2025_robotic text)
n_dof_detail: 3-4 (mandhumula2025_robotic Table 1); robot 'controlling all six knobs at the same time' (santacruzworks_capstan, D. Wallace)
translation_detail: friction-roller (mandhumula2025_robotic Table 1 'Friction rollers'; Fig. 2I 'Drive-mechanism consisting roller assembly')
rotation_detail: steerable-catheter deflection by a multi-spool tendon mechanism that also deploys the implant (mandhumula2025_robotic text, Table 1 'Pull-wires'); shaft rotation N.R.
sterility: N.R. (robot draped in an animal-lab photo, santacruzworks_capstan)
validation_detail: human: 2 TMVR patients at Hospital Clinico Universidad Catolica, Santiago, both with mitral regurgitation eliminated and unobstructed LVOT (capstan2025_press, 2025-03-06); registered FIH study NCT06600191: 10 participants (estimated), 4 sites (Melbourne, Sao Paulo, Santiago, Auckland), recruiting (nct06600191_capstan, accessed 2026-11-08)
key_numbers: NCT06600191 first posted 2024-09-19, start 2025-02-24, primary completion 2026-12 (estimated), last update 2026-08-28 (nct06600191_capstan); USD 110 M financing (PR Newswire 2024-12-11)

notes: Family: commercial (A4 scope; clinical-stage). No peer-reviewed paper; patents (Wallace 2024, mandhumula2025_robotic refs 62-64) not opened. Structural-heart (TMVR) robot, in scope like the TEER robots. Company site and press releases carry no photo of the robot; the only photo found shows it draped in an animal lab (gallery).
